START YOUR OWN FREELANCE BUSINESS 
  IAPWE Professional Development Series 1 Introductory Email Worksheet  Write an introduction to your new business, what you do, who you created your services for, what problems your service will solve, and a clear call to action. Using this information, create an email template that you can send out to potential clients. Personalize and add a note for each person, keeping it to 1-2 sentences Introduction
